import { Component, Input, Output, EventEmitter, OnChanges, SimpleChanges, ViewChild, ElementRef, AfterViewChecked } from '@angular/core'; import { ConversationData, ConversationItem, ConversationMessage, isSystemMessage, SystemMessage } from '@/app/core/models'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { MessagesService } from '@/app/core/services/messages.service'; import { mockRecipients, Recipient } from '@/app/core/data/companies.mock'; import { highlightText } from '@/app/core/utils/search.utils'; import { RichTextEditorComponent } from '@/app/shared/components/rich-text-editor/rich-text-editor.component'; import { CompanyDisplayComponent } from '@/app/shared/components/company-display/company-display.component'; import { ParticipantService } from '@/app/core/services/participant.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-conversation-detail', styles: [` :host { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } ::ng-deep .rich-text-content { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.15; } ::ng-deep .rich-text-content font { line-height: normal; } `], template: `

Select a conversation to view messages

{{ conversation.title }}

Updated: {{ conversation.lastUpdated }}
{{ r.name }} | {{ r.role }}
{{ tempSelectedMembers.size }} selected
{{ member }}
Search
Users in my portfolio
Other bank users
Added participants will have access to the conversation history
{{ oooParticipants[0].name }} is Out of Office until {{ oooParticipants[0].returnDate }} and {{ oooParticipants.length - 1 }} others
{{ unreadCount }} NEW MESSAGES
{{ formatSystemText(item) }}
{{ formatSystemText(item) }}
{{ item.timestamp }}
{{ asMessage(item).replyTo?.sender }} {{ asMessage(item).replyTo?.timestamp }}
{{ att.name }}
{{ att.type }}
{{ att.size }}
{{ att.name }}
{{ att.type }}
{{ att.size }}
You can no longer send messages
{{ oooParticipants[0].name }} is Out of Office until {{ oooParticipants[0].returnDate }} and {{ oooParticipants.length - 1 }} others

Are you sure you want to remove {{ participantToRemove }} from the conversation?

These will still have access to the chat history.

` }) export class ConversationDetailComponent implements OnChanges, AfterViewChecked { showScrollButton = false; @ViewChild('scrollContainer') private scrollContainer!: ElementRef; @Input() messageId: string | null = null; @Input() searchQuery: string = ''; @Input() folder: string | undefined = 'Inbox'; @Output() todoStatusChange = new EventEmitter<{ id: string, hasTodo: boolean }>(); @Output() wasReadUntilEnd = new EventEmitter(); @Output() markUnread = new EventEmitter(); @Output() deleteConversation = new EventEmitter(); @Output() restoreConversation = new EventEmitter(); @ViewChild('unreadSeparator') unreadSeparator!: ElementRef; @ViewChild('scrollBottom') scrollBottom!: ElementRef; @ViewChild('memberInput') memberInput!: ElementRef; conversation: ConversationData | null = null; // Edit Members State isEditMembersMode = false; draftParticipants: string[] = []; memberSearchQuery = ''; showMemberSuggestions = false; participantToRemove: string | null = null; groupedSuggestions = { portfolio: [] as any[], otherBank: [] as any[] }; get hasNewParticipants(): boolean { if (!this.conversation || !this.conversation.participantsList) return false; return this.draftParticipants.some(p => !this.conversation!.participantsList.includes(p)); } draftContent: string = ''; highlightedMessageId: string | null = null; isMemberDropdownOpen = false; replyingToMessage: ConversationMessage | null = null; isOOOBannerDismissed = false; constructor( private messagesService: MessagesService, private participantService: ParticipantService, private router: Router ) { } ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges) { if (changes['messageId']) { this.isOOOBannerDismissed = false; if (this.messageId) { this.loadConversation(this.messageId); // Restore draft from service this.draftContent = this.messagesService.getDraft(this.messageId); } else { this.conversation = null; this.draftContent = ''; } } } ngAfterViewChecked() { } loadConversation(id: string) { this.messagesService.getConversation(id).subscribe(data => { this.conversation = data; this.handleInitialScroll(); }); } isFirstUnread(item: ConversationItem): boolean { if (!this.conversation || !this.conversation.messages || this.unreadCount === 0) return false; const index = this.conversation.messages.indexOf(item); const firstUnreadIndex = this.conversation.messages.length - this.unreadCount; return index === firstUnreadIndex; } handleInitialScroll() { this.showScrollButton = false; setTimeout(() => { const separator = document.getElementById('first-unread-separator'); if (separator) { separator.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'auto', block: 'center' }); } else if (this.scrollContainer) { this.scrollContainer.nativeElement.scrollTop = this.scrollContainer.nativeElement.scrollHeight; } }, 100); } get unreadCount(): number { if (!this.conversation) return 0; // Prioritize explicit unreadCount from data if available (for mock/testing) if ((this.conversation as any).unreadCount !== undefined) { return (this.conversation as any).unreadCount; } return this.conversation.messages.filter(m => !isSystemMessage(m) && (m as ConversationMessage).isRead === false).length; } get todoMessages(): ConversationMessage[] { if (!this.conversation) return []; return this.conversation.messages .filter((item): item is ConversationMessage => !this.isSystem(item) && !!(item as ConversationMessage).isTodo); } isSystem(item: ConversationItem): boolean { return isSystemMessage(item); } asMessage(item: ConversationItem): ConversationMessage { return item as ConversationMessage; } asSystem(item: ConversationItem): SystemMessage { return item as SystemMessage; } formatSystemText(item: any): string { const { type, actor, targetUser, organization } = item; const pronoun = this.getGenderPronoun(targetUser); switch (type) { case 'member_added': if (actor === 'System') return `${targetUser} has been added to the conversation`; return `${actor} added ${targetUser} to the conversation`; case 'member_removed': return `${actor} removed ${targetUser} from the conversation`; case 'you_were_added': return `${actor} added You to the conversation`; case 'you_were_removed': return `${actor} removed You from the conversation`; case 'member_left_org': return `${targetUser} was removed from the conversation because ${pronoun} is no longer part of ${organization}`; case 'you_left_org': return `You were removed from the conversation because you are no longer part of ${organization}`; case 'banker_replaced': return `${targetUser} was removed from the conversation as ${pronoun} is no longer assigned to organisation`; case 'forward_separator': return 'FORWARDED MESSAGES ABOVE'; default: return 'System notification'; } } getGenderPronoun(name: string): string { const femaleEndings = ['a', 'ia', 'na', 'la', 'cia', 'sia']; const lowerName = name.toLowerCase(); // Check first name (split by space) const firstName = lowerName.split(' ')[0]; if (femaleEndings.some(ending => firstName.endsWith(ending))) { return 'she'; } return 'he'; } onForwardConversation() { if (this.messageId) { this.router.navigate(['/messages/forward', this.messageId]); } } getMemberIconName(name: string): string { const bankTerms = ['unicredit', 'wilson thomas', 'rossi mario']; const lower = name.toLowerCase(); if (bankTerms.some(term => lower.includes(term))) return 'member-bank'; if (name.length % 5 === 0 && !lower.includes('(you)')) return 'member-bank'; return 'member-client'; } get sortedParticipants(): string[] { if (!this.conversation?.participantsList) return []; return [...this.conversation.participantsList].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)); } get hasParticipantMatch(): boolean { if (!this.searchQuery || !this.conversation?.participantsList) return false; const query = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase(); return this.conversation.participantsList.some(p => p.toLowerCase().includes(query)); } highlightMember(name: string): string { return highlightText(name, this.searchQuery); } getContent(item: ConversationItem): string { if (!isSystemMessage(item)) { return (item as any).content || ''; } return ''; } getSender(item: ConversationItem): string { if (!isSystemMessage(item)) { return (item as any).sender || ''; } return ''; } getIsOwn(item: ConversationItem): boolean { if (!isSystemMessage(item)) { return !!(item as any).isOwn; } return false; } highlight(text: string | undefined): string { return highlightText(text, this.searchQuery); } highlightContent(content: string): string { if (!this.searchQuery) return content; return highlightText(content, this.searchQuery); } scrollToMessage(id: string) { this.highlightedMessageId = id; setTimeout(() => { const el = document.getElementById('message-' + id); if (el) { el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' }); } setTimeout(() => this.highlightedMessageId = null, 3000); }, 100); } onScroll(event: any): void { const element = event.target; // Show button if we are not at the bottom (threshold 100px) const atBottom = element.scrollHeight - element.scrollTop <= element.clientHeight + 10; this.showScrollButton = !atBottom; if (atBottom && this.messageId) { this.wasReadUntilEnd.emit(this.messageId); } } scrollToNewest(): void { if (this.scrollContainer) { this.scrollContainer.nativeElement.scrollTo({ top: this.scrollContainer.nativeElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); } } toggleTodoStatus(id: string) { if (!this.messageId) return; this.messagesService.toggleMessageTodo(this.messageId, id); } @ViewChild(RichTextEditorComponent) richTextEditor!: RichTextEditorComponent; handleDraftChange(content: string) { this.draftContent = content; if (this.messageId) { this.messagesService.setDraft(this.messageId, content); } } sendMessage() { if (!this.draftContent || !this.draftContent.trim() || !this.conversation || !this.messageId) return; // Mock send const newMessage: ConversationMessage = { id: `msg-${Date.now()}`, sender: 'You', content: this.draftContent, timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false }), isOwn: true, isTodo: false, replyTo: this.replyingToMessage ? { ...this.replyingToMessage } : undefined }; this.conversation.messages = [...this.conversation.messages, newMessage]; // Clear local draft, service draft and reply state const id = this.messageId; this.draftContent = ''; this.replyingToMessage = null; this.messagesService.setDraft(id!, ''); if (this.richTextEditor) { this.richTextEditor.clear(); } // Scroll to bottom setTimeout(() => { if (this.scrollBottom) { this.scrollBottom.nativeElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); } }, 100); } onReplyMessage(message: ConversationMessage) { this.replyingToMessage = message; if (this.richTextEditor) { this.richTextEditor.focus(); } } cancelReply() { this.replyingToMessage = null; } toggleReplyExpand(message: ConversationMessage) { message.isReplyExpanded = !message.isReplyExpanded; } shouldShowReadMore(content: string | undefined): boolean { if (!content) return false; // Simple heuristic: if content has many chars or multiple lines return content.length > 200 || content.includes('
') || content.includes('
'); } showOOOBanner = true; isMemberOOO(name: string): boolean { const r = this.participantService.getRecipientByName(name); return !!r?.outOfOffice?.isOoo; } getMemberOOODate(name: string): string { const r = this.participantService.getRecipientByName(name); return r?.outOfOffice?.returnDate || ''; } get oooParticipants(): { name: string, returnDate: string }[] { if (!this.conversation?.participantsList) return []; return this.conversation.participantsList .filter(name => this.isMemberOOO(name)) .map(name => ({ name, returnDate: this.getMemberOOODate(name) })); } get oooBannerText(): string { const ooo = this.oooParticipants; if (ooo.length === 0) return ''; if (ooo.length === 1) { const p = ooo[0]; // Remove (You) for cleaner display const name = p.name.replace(' (You)', '').trim(); return `${name} Out of office: Returning ${p.returnDate}`; } else { // Multiple users const names = ooo.map(p => p.name.replace(' (You)', '').trim()).join(', '); return `${names} Out of office`; } } dismissOOOBanner() { this.showOOOBanner = false; } getConversationCompanies(): string[] { if (!this.conversation || !this.conversation.participantsList) { return []; } return this.participantService.getCompaniesFromParticipants(this.conversation.participantsList); } // ================================================================================================= // EDIT MEMBERS LOGIC // ================================================================================================= startEditMembers() { if (!this.conversation) return; this.isEditMembersMode = true; this.isMemberDropdownOpen = false; // Close the dropdown this.draftParticipants = [...(this.conversation.participantsList || [])]; } cancelEditMembers() { this.isEditMembersMode = false; this.draftParticipants = []; this.memberSearchQuery = ''; } saveEditMembers() { if (!this.conversation) return; const original = this.conversation.participantsList || []; const current = this.draftParticipants; // Find added const added = current.filter(p => !original.includes(p)); // Find removed const removed = original.filter(p => !current.includes(p)); if (added.length === 0 && removed.length === 0) { this.isEditMembersMode = false; return; } // Apply changes this.conversation.participantsList = [...current]; // Generate System Messages const currentUser = 'White Dan'; // Mock current user removed.forEach(name => { const msg: SystemMessage = { id: `sys-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`, type: 'member_removed', actor: currentUser, targetUser: name, timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(), organization: 'UniCredit' }; this.conversation!.messages.push(msg); }); added.forEach(name => { const msg: SystemMessage = { id: `sys-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`, type: 'member_added', actor: currentUser, targetUser: name, timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(), organization: 'UniCredit' }; this.conversation!.messages.push(msg); }); // Scroll to bottom to see activity setTimeout(() => { if (this.scrollBottom) { this.scrollBottom.nativeElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); } }, 100); this.isEditMembersMode = false; } // Search & Add onMemberSearch() { const query = this.memberSearchQuery.toLowerCase().trim(); if (!query) { this.showMemberSuggestions = false; return; } const result = mockRecipients.filter(r => !this.draftParticipants.includes(r.name) && (r.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || r.role.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ); // Grouping this.groupedSuggestions.portfolio = []; this.groupedSuggestions.otherBank = []; result.forEach(r => { const type = this.participantService.getParticipantType(r.name); if (type === 'client') { this.groupedSuggestions.portfolio.push(r); } else { this.groupedSuggestions.otherBank.push(r); } }); this.showMemberSuggestions = true; } onMemberInputFocus() { if (this.memberSearchQuery) { this.showMemberSuggestions = true; } } onMemberInputBlur() { setTimeout(() => { this.showMemberSuggestions = false; }, 200); } addParticipant(user: Recipient) { if (!this.draftParticipants.includes(user.name)) { this.draftParticipants.push(user.name); } this.memberSearchQuery = ''; this.showMemberSuggestions = false; if (this.memberInput) { this.memberInput.nativeElement.focus(); } } // Remove Flow requestRemoveParticipant(name: string) { this.participantToRemove = name; } confirmRemoveParticipant() { if (this.participantToRemove) { this.draftParticipants = this.draftParticipants.filter(p => p !== this.participantToRemove); this.participantToRemove = null; } } cancelRemoveParticipant() { this.participantToRemove = null; } // Member Picker Logic showMemberPicker = false; pickerSearchQuery = ''; tempSelectedMembers = new Set(); toggleMemberPicker() { this.showMemberPicker = !this.showMemberPicker; if (this.showMemberPicker) { this.pickerSearchQuery = ''; this.tempSelectedMembers = new Set(this.draftParticipants); } } isMemberSelectedInPicker(name: string): boolean { return this.tempSelectedMembers.has(name); } toggleMemberPickerSelection(name: string) { if (this.tempSelectedMembers.has(name)) { this.tempSelectedMembers.delete(name); } else { this.tempSelectedMembers.add(name); } } getFilteredPickerMembers() { const query = this.pickerSearchQuery.toLowerCase(); return mockRecipients.filter(r => !query || r.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || r.role.toLowerCase().includes(query) ); } applyMemberPickerSelection() { this.draftParticipants = Array.from(this.tempSelectedMembers); this.showMemberPicker = false; } closeMemberPicker() { this.showMemberPicker = false; } }
